test_title: PYST 12: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 13 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Marshal is sitting second to the left of Sandra. Carol is sitting second to the right of Sandra. Shashi is the immediate neighbour of Sandra and Carol. Sahil is sitting third to the left of Sandra. Jade is sitting third to the left of Carol. Who is sitting between Marshal and Carol?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Given:- Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Marshal is sitting second to the left of Sandra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd2a2a5e7e3db88c90915e99ced30f835acbf2ab26885be4ccdc81119ce0b749.png] 

2) Carol is sitting second to the right of Sandra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd8236227f10f1ecf41e5df58a31e622095b9c2a37e9cd8a4d370fb8b365f614.png] 

3) Shashi is the immediate neighbour of Sandra and Carol.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e20e53bf392171a312caee88c8cef6930a1717fc9bca1f13c06a7691924b94f.png] 

4) Sahil is sitting third to the left of Sandra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ff270c5a03a03d43fc2ba3c8b139a5102becdc1219936a7ee433f77c44c21e6.png] 

5) Jade is sitting third to the left of Carol.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/821c82e6b0b32c0cd23fd6f8274e2f96ec583b35ba08882696bbbdeb95906375.png] 

Clearly, Sahil is sitting between Marshal and Carol.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Sahil".**
